subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching behavior be implemented as a LINE-owned plugin option, a generic plugin SDK/channel aggregation seam, or a broader gateway/session coalescing feature?
rationale: The LINE source gap is clear, but buffering media changes public config and cross-message turn semantics; repository policy treats that as product/API direction rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: LINE-owned opt-in buffer
options.body: Add a focused LINE plugin option that batches same-sender media by account and conversation without changing shared debounce defaults.

options.title: Generic SDK seam first
options.body: Design a reusable channel aggregation contract so LINE, WhatsApp, and future channels can opt into the same media-aware behavior consistently.

options.title: Gateway coalescer RFC
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers approve a broader gateway/session coalescing model with transcript metadata and command-bypass semantics.

recommendation.title: LINE-owned opt-in buffer
recommendation.body: Add a focused LINE plugin option that batches same-sender media by account and conversation without changing shared debounce defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The narrow recommended option lands in the LINE plugin files where current blame and recent history point most strongly to vincentkoc.
